description: This file defines a custom authentication success handler for Spring Security. It extends Spring's SimpleUrlAuthenticationSuccessHandler to perform specific actions upon user authentication success, such as managing saved requests and request cache.

classes.name: ServicesAuthenticationSuccessHandler
classes.description: A custom handler that manages post-authentication success behavior, including request cache management, for Spring Security.

methods.name: onAuthenticationSuccess
methods.description: Overrides the default method to handle logic after user authentication, managing saved requests and clearing authentication attributes.

methods.name: setRequestCache
methods.description: Allows setting a custom RequestCache instance.
